title: Parcel & Zoning Lookup
exercises: 1 - simple single-map WAB. Must recommend Instant App, not EXB.

title: Public Works Asset Viewer
exercises: 2 - multi-widget, multi-page WAB. Must recommend Experience Builder.

title: Snow Plow Route Status
exercises: 3 - WAB with a custom widget package. Must recommend Custom; widget package detection.

title: Historic District Survey (2019)
exercises: 4 - deleted owner, 0 views. Retire recommendation; owner_exists=0; v_orphaned; v_dead. Also the no-tags case.

title: Development Projects Map
exercises: 5 - PUBLIC app -> web map -> ORG-ONLY layer. The audit-sharing headline case.

title: Utility Locate Request Viewer
exercises: 6 - production app referencing the dev host. Dev/staging detection.

title: Flood Awareness Map, "Know Your Risk"
exercises: 7 - depends on an http:// map service. Also the nasty-title case: comma, double quote, and a newline in the snippet, for CSV/Excel escaping.

title: Election Precinct Finder
exercises: 8 - hand-built app on ArcGIS API for JavaScript 3.42. JS 3.x scanner rule; custom_js_app classification. Note the absent Web AppBuilder typeKeywords --- classification has to lean on the data JSON, hence confidence=likely.

title: Street Resurfacing Program
exercises: 9 - well-formed Experience Builder app. NEGATIVE CASE: must produce no findings.

title: Park & Trail Finder
exercises: 10 - EXB whose config has accessibility problems (missing widget labels, fixed layout, no alt text). Feeds BU2's static auditor later; must still classify cleanly here.

title: Water Main Break Dashboard
exercises: 11 - Dashboard. Classified, but NOT recommended for migration.

title: Address Point Lookup
exercises: 12 - Instant App. Classified, not recommended for migration.

title: Downtown Streetscape Plan
exercises: 13 - StoryMap. Classified, not recommended for migration.

title: Bike Path Network
exercises: 14 - item data JSON is malformed. crawl_error path; the crawl continues and the run ends `partial`. Classification falls back to typeKeywords alone, hence confidence=guess.

title: Internal Facilities Viewer
exercises: 15 - item data returns 403. Recorded as a crawl_error and a finding, never a crash. This is the case that usually means the crawling account cannot see something.

title: Parcels & Zoning
exercises: 16 - used by apps 1 and 4, so it survives when app 4 is retired. Fan-in; v_shared_maps. The three-app fan-in case is item 19.

title: Storm Sewer Network
exercises: 17 - one layer's service is a 404. Reachability finding; reachable=0.

title: Traffic Signals
exercises: 18 - references a service by URL with no itemId. Forces an `endpoint` node with no item_id, which is the case a two-table design gets wrong.

title: Utilities Master
exercises: 19 - group layers nested four levels deep. Recursion depth in edge extraction. Also the top fan-in case: used by apps 2, 6, and the dashboard, so v_shared_maps ranks it first --- migrate once, fix many.

title: Tree Inventory
exercises: 20 - basemap from outside the org. External domain detection.

title: Fire Hydrant Inspection
exercises: 21 - an Arcade expression reaches into another layer. `arcade_source` edges.

title: Street Centerlines
exercises: 22 - the same service at two indexes, and index 0 twice. URL normalization: ONE endpoint node, and edges distinguished by source_path.

title: Downtown 3D Buildings
exercises: 23 - Web Scene. Non-map spatial item classification.

title: Address Points
exercises: numViews = null. Null is not zero --- 'unknown usage' is a different recommendation from 'unused'.

title: Plow Routes
exercises: Folder name contains a forward slash (path construction on export), and `modified` is in the FUTURE relative to the fixture's run date. Clock skew is real.

title: Parks
exercises: `modified` is null. Not the same as old.

title: Floodplain & Floodway
exercises: Carries case 7's http:// dependency down from the app.

title: Development Projects
exercises: The middle of the headline chain: public map over an org-only layer.

title: Parks
exercises: Identical title to item 26, in a different folder. Duplicate detection must key on item id, not title.

title: Northgate Plow Status 🚜 widget — v2 (café build)
exercises: The custom widget package behind app 3. Non-ASCII characters and an emoji in the title (Windows console codepage will find you), and 200 tags.
